description: Election Commission - Mr. N. Nirainjan of the Point Pedro Urban Council has vacated his office of member
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically concerns a member vacating office in a local authority (Point Pedro Urban Council) due to ceasing membership in a political party (Tamil United Liberation Front). The notice is issued under Section 10 A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it directly related to electoral processes and the administration of local government elections, which falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
